# BuildrWeb

> Remote-first studio building websites, AI voice agents and business automations for UK tradespeople and local service businesses (plumbers, electricians, roofers, builders, dentists, restaurants, estate agents).

## Services
- WordPress Websites
- AI-Powered Website Development
- AI Voice Agents (24/7 call answering, booking, lead qualification)
- Business Automations (confirmations, reminders, lead routing, CRM updates)
- Local SEO and Speed
